speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) whether electric bicycles, electric scooters and other personal mobility devices requiring the charging of their batteries are designated as controlled goods under the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme and, if not, whether they should be so designated to ensure they meet safety standards.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: This is something that we can ask SPRING to have a look at.
